requestBody.query: how to program my Bell remote to control my audio for sat

200.answer: To program your Bell remote to control your audio for satellite, select the device you want the remote to control using the SAT, TV, AUX, or VCR buttons. The remote needs to be programmed for that specific device.

snippets.text: Reminder: To control your TV, VCR, DVD player, or another device, your remote needs to be programmed for that device. Find out how to program your remote here. Remote features SAT-TV-VCR-AUX SAT/TV/VCR/AUX These buttons let you select which device the remote will control.
snippets.title: Bell Satellite TV remote control basics

snippets.text: Learn more Learn how to program your Bell Satellite TV remote How to program your bell satellite tv remote - opens a video modal dialog To operate your receiver If you find that your Bell Satellite TV remote is not controlling your receiver properly, or if you recently purchased a replacement remote, follow these steps to program it. Important: If you have a UHF remote (check the bottom of your remote), you first need to install the UHF antenna provided by Bell into its port on the back of your receiver. Press SYS INFO on the front of the receiver. Press and hold SAT until SAT, TV, AUX and VCR light up. Release SAT. It will start to flash. Choose a random number between 0 and 16 and enter it. This will reset the frequency the remote uses to communicate with the receiver. Press #. Press Record. The remote address field on the System Info screen will display the number you selected. Press Done. You will now be able to control the receiver.

snippets.text: Using the direction buttons on the receiver, scroll down to Apps and press OK/Select on the receiver. Scroll to Bell apps and press OK/Select. Scroll to Fibe TV app and press OK/Select. Scroll to Pair Device and press OK/Select. Press OK/Select once the device with the Fibe.

snippets.text: To pair your remote using IR: With your Bell Streamer remote, select Settings from the left navigation menu. Under the Device section, select Universal remote. Follow the IR remote pairing process on the screen.

snippets.text: If none of the above steps restore your sound, please contact us for further assistance. No sound on some channels - expanded Try any of the following: Ensure that you are not on a descriptive video channel (located from channel 99 and below). If so, find the regular channel. Ensure that alternate audio is turned off, and that the audio is set to English. How to turn off alternate audio Models 9500,7500 and 6500 Press the Menu button on your Bell Satellite TV remote control. Select Settings. Select Preferences. Select Alternate Audio. Select English and then Done. All other models Press the Menu button on your Bell Satellite TV remote control. Select System Setup or Preferences. Select Alternate Audio. Select English and then Save. Was this article useful? Yes No Thank you. We have received your response. In our ongoing efforts to improve our support section, your opinion is invaluable.

snippets.text: Select Search on your TV screen. Highlight the program you want and press SELECT on your remote. If the program you searched for starts at a later time, the Create timer menu will appear. Choose the timer option and frequency that you would like for this program.
